user_direction: 目标是livgo，只是livo2没伤害那是不够的
target_rule: Each of the seven T odometry ATE medians must be <= the published FAST-LIVGO value; no pooled average or LIVO2 non-harm substitute. Literal rounded paper thresholds, fixed before evaluation.
expand_only_after: All seven five-seed main-table targets and instrument checks pass.
auxiliary_aruco: Defer GNSS-denial01/02 replays until the missing E5 endpoint evaluator exists; never call their replay completion an ATE result.
evaluation_guard: Use frozen build/configuration; no parameter changes or sequence/seed selection from evaluation results.
claim_limit: Paper-number target match; FAST-LIVGO has not been reproduced in the same environment. GT masks, Outdoor01 repair gap, and upstream baseline differences must remain disclosed.
